title: Act 3 - Chapter 1: Knot Island, Treasure Beach, Kindle Road & Mt. Ember
synopsis: Begin the Sevii Islands postgame campaign! Board the ferry from Cinnabar Island to Knot Island, assist Bebe with the lost Network Adapter at Treasure Beach to earn the Box Link, journey north along Kindle Road past the Ember Spa hot springs, and defeat Team Rocket at Mt. Ember to secure the Seagallop Pass under the Level 72 cap.
